quotes.q1: If liberty means anything at all, it means the right to tell people what they do not want to hear.
quotes.q2: I disapprove of what you say, but I will defend to the death your right to say it.
quotes.q3: The right to free speech and the unrealistic expectation to never be offended can not coexist.
quotes.q4: At no time is freedom of speech more precious than when a man hits his thumb with a hammer.
quotes.q5: Freedom of speech means freedom for those who you despise, and freedom to express the most despicable views.
quotes.q6: Ignorant free speech often works against the speaker. That is one of several reasons why it must be given rein instead of suppressed.
quotes.q7: Freedom of speech includes the freedom to offend people.
quotes.q8: There is a fine line between free speech and hate speech. Free speech encourages debate whereas hate speech incites violence.
quotes.q9: Freedom of speech means that you shall not do something to people either for the views they have, or the views they express, or the words they speak or write.
